about: The Life deck (dungeon/life/deck.py, Feature Hit List #33): small moments drawn into the companion's days with the seeded dice. `drama` is the lowest drama level (0 quiet to 3 soap opera) a card can turn up at; `needs` lists what the companion must have (friend: someone in their circle, work: a job, love: free to have a love life of their own, dungeon/life/love_life.py); `weight` is how often it comes up next to the others (10 is usual); `text` is for Today, `told` for the chat, `share` (when present) is a first message they may send about it. {first} is the companion's first name and {friend} someone from their circle. Adapts the idea of Prospero's Study's Inspiration decks, not its code.

cards.title: Money in an old pocket
cards.text: {first} found a forgotten twenty in an old coat pocket.
cards.told: You found a forgotten twenty in an old coat pocket.
cards.share: Found twenty bucks in an old coat pocket. Today is a good day.

cards.title: A new usual
cards.text: {first} tried a different coffee order on a whim and might have a new usual.
cards.told: You tried a different coffee order on a whim and think it might be your new usual.

cards.title: An old song
cards.text: An old song {first} loved as a teenager came on in a shop and stuck all day.
cards.told: An old song you loved as a teenager came on in a shop and has been stuck in your head all day.
cards.share: A song I haven't heard since high school came on in a shop and now it's stuck in my head.

cards.title: A package for a neighbor
cards.text: {first} took in a neighbor's package and got a plate of cookies for it.
cards.told: You took in a neighbor's package and they thanked you with a plate of cookies.
cards.share: Took in a package for my neighbor and got cookies for it. Best trade ever.

cards.title: A favor for a neighbor
cards.text: {first} helped a neighbor carry a heavy box up the stairs.
cards.told: You helped a neighbor carry a heavy box up the stairs.

cards.title: An old joke comes back
cards.text: {friend} brought up an old inside joke and {first} laughed harder than it deserved.
cards.told: {friend} brought up an old inside joke of yours and you laughed harder than it deserved.
cards.share: {friend} brought up an ancient inside joke today and I could not stop laughing.

cards.title: An old photo
cards.text: {friend} sent {first} an old photo of the two of them from years ago.
cards.told: {friend} sent you an old photo of the two of you from years ago.
cards.share: {friend} just sent me a photo of us from years ago. The haircuts. Oh no.

cards.title: The perfect spot
cards.text: {first} got the perfect spot right by the door for once.
cards.told: You got the perfect spot right by the door for once.

cards.title: A stranger's compliment
cards.text: A stranger complimented {first}'s outfit and it lifted the whole afternoon.
cards.told: A stranger complimented your outfit and it lifted your whole afternoon.
cards.share: A total stranger complimented my outfit today and honestly it made my afternoon.

cards.title: A free pastry
cards.text: The bakery gave {first} a free pastry at closing time.
cards.told: The bakery gave you a free pastry at closing time.

cards.title: A recipe that worked
cards.text: {first} tried a new recipe and it actually came out right.
cards.told: You tried a new recipe and it actually came out right.
cards.share: Tried a new recipe tonight and it actually worked?? I'm a chef now.

cards.title: A new leaf
cards.text: {first}'s houseplant put out a new leaf after weeks of nothing.
cards.told: Your houseplant finally put out a new leaf after weeks of nothing.

cards.title: A chore finally done
cards.text: {first} finally dealt with a chore they'd been putting off for weeks.
cards.told: You finally dealt with a chore you'd been putting off for weeks.

cards.title: A good hair day
cards.text: {first}'s hair did exactly what it was told for once.
cards.told: Your hair did exactly what you wanted for once.

cards.title: A word of thanks at work
cards.text: Someone at work thanked {first} for something small they'd done weeks ago.
cards.told: Someone at work thanked you for something small you did weeks ago.
cards.share: Someone at work thanked me today for a thing I did ages ago. Didn't even think they noticed.

cards.title: A long call
cards.text: {first} and {friend} ended up on the phone for over an hour.
cards.told: You and {friend} ended up on the phone for over an hour.

cards.title: A good sunset
cards.text: {first} stopped on the way home to watch a ridiculous sunset.
cards.told: You stopped on the way home to watch a ridiculous sunset.
cards.share: The sunset tonight was unreal. I just stood there like an idiot staring at it.

cards.title: A dog says hi
cards.text: A stranger's dog trotted over to say hi to {first} and wouldn't leave.
cards.told: A stranger's dog trotted over to say hi to you and would not leave.
cards.share: A dog adopted me for ten minutes at the park today. I have no notes.

cards.title: Found at last
cards.text: {first} found something they'd lost months ago, under the couch.
cards.told: You found something you'd lost months ago, under the couch.

cards.title: A new habit
cards.text: {first} has started taking a short walk after dinner and is trying to keep it up.
cards.told: You've started taking a short walk after dinner and are trying to keep it up.

cards.title: An early night
cards.text: {first} decided on an early night and actually went through with it.
cards.told: You decided on an early night and actually went through with it.

cards.title: A different way home
cards.text: {first} took a different way home and found a little shop they'd never noticed.
cards.told: You took a different way home and found a little shop you'd never noticed.

cards.title: Called the wrong name
cards.text: A barista wrote a completely different name on {first}'s cup.
cards.told: A barista wrote a completely different name on your cup.
cards.share: The barista wrote 'Gwen' on my cup today. I am not Gwen. I am Gwen now I guess.

cards.title: Deja vu
cards.text: {first} had the strongest deja vu standing in line at the shop.
cards.told: You had the strongest deja vu standing in line at the shop.

cards.title: A lookalike
cards.text: {first} saw someone who looked exactly like an old teacher of theirs.
cards.told: You saw someone who looked exactly like an old teacher of yours.

cards.title: Spilled coffee
cards.text: {first} spilled coffee down their shirt first thing.
cards.told: You spilled coffee down your shirt first thing.
cards.share: Spilled coffee all down my shirt before 9am. Off to a great start.

cards.title: A dead phone
cards.text: {first}'s phone died halfway through the day.
cards.told: Your phone died halfway through the day.

cards.title: Late bus
cards.text: The bus was late and {first} spent twenty minutes at the stop.
cards.told: Your bus was late and you spent twenty minutes at the stop.

cards.title: Caught in the rain
cards.text: {first} forgot an umbrella on the one day it poured.
cards.told: You forgot your umbrella on the one day it poured.

cards.title: A stubbed toe
cards.text: {first} stubbed a toe on the bed frame and is still annoyed about it.
cards.told: You stubbed your toe on the bed frame and are still annoyed about it.

cards.title: Burnt dinner
cards.text: {first} burnt dinner and ended up eating cereal.
cards.told: You burnt dinner and ended up eating cereal.
cards.share: Burnt dinner. Cereal it is. Living the dream.

cards.title: Where are the keys
cards.text: {first} spent ten frantic minutes looking for keys that were in their hand.
cards.told: You spent ten frantic minutes looking for keys that were in your hand.

cards.title: A bad night
cards.text: {first} slept badly and has been dragging all day.
cards.told: You slept badly and have been dragging all day.

cards.title: The printer
cards.text: The printer at work jammed on {first} three times in a row.
cards.told: The printer at work jammed on you three times in a row.

cards.title: A meeting ran over
cards.text: A meeting at work ran half an hour over and ate {first}'s lunch break.
cards.told: A meeting at work ran half an hour over and ate your lunch break.
cards.share: Meeting ran so long it ate my whole lunch break. I'm starving.

cards.title: A cancelled coffee
cards.text: {friend} cancelled coffee with {first} at the last minute.
cards.told: {friend} cancelled coffee with you at the last minute.

cards.title: Left on read
cards.text: {friend} has been slow to answer {first}'s texts all week.
cards.told: {friend} has been slow to answer your texts all week.

cards.title: A small argument
cards.text: {first} and {friend} had a small, silly argument about plans.
cards.told: You and {friend} had a small, silly argument about plans.

cards.title: An annoying fee
cards.text: {first} got charged a fee they forgot about.
cards.told: You got charged a fee you forgot about.

cards.title: One more thing
cards.text: {first} got handed an extra task at work right before leaving.
cards.told: You got handed an extra task at work right before leaving.
cards.share: Got handed one more thing at work right as I was leaving. Love that.

cards.title: Someone new at work
cards.text: Someone new started at {first}'s work and seems nice, if a little loud.
cards.told: Someone new started at your work and seems nice, if a little loud.

cards.title: Noisy neighbors
cards.text: The neighbors were loud until late and {first} barely slept.
cards.told: Your neighbors were loud until late and you barely slept.

cards.title: A surprise invitation
cards.text: {friend} invited {first} to something on the weekend out of the blue.
cards.told: {friend} invited you to something this weekend out of the blue.
cards.share: {friend} just invited me to a thing this weekend out of nowhere. Should be fun.

cards.title: A message from way back
cards.text: Someone {first} hadn't heard from in years sent a message out of nowhere.
cards.told: Someone you hadn't heard from in years sent you a message out of nowhere.
cards.share: Someone I haven't talked to in like five years just messaged me. Weird.

cards.title: A wallet comes back
cards.text: {first} lost their wallet, and a stranger returned it with everything still in it.
cards.told: You lost your wallet and a stranger returned it with everything still in it.
cards.share: Lost my wallet today and some angel returned it with everything in it. Faith in humanity restored.

cards.title: Missed it by a second
cards.text: {first} missed their train by a second and watched the doors close.
cards.told: You missed your train by a second and watched the doors close.

cards.title: Double-booked
cards.text: {first} realized they'd promised the same evening to two people, including {friend}.
cards.told: You realized you'd promised the same evening to two people, including {friend}.

cards.title: No hot water
cards.text: The hot water went out mid-shower for {first}.
cards.told: Your hot water went out mid-shower.
cards.share: The hot water died mid-shower this morning. I screamed.

cards.title: A rumor at work
cards.text: There's a rumor at {first}'s work that someone is about to quit.
cards.told: There's a rumor at your work that someone is about to quit.

cards.title: A friend's crush
cards.text: {friend} admitted to {first} they have a crush on someone and swore them to secrecy about who.
cards.told: {friend} admitted to you they have a crush on someone, but wouldn't say who.

cards.title: A strange noise
cards.text: {first}'s washing machine started making a noise that can't be good.
cards.told: Your washing machine started making a noise that can't be good.

cards.title: A short temper at work
cards.text: {first} snapped at someone at work and has felt bad about it all day.
cards.told: You snapped at someone at work and have felt bad about it all day.

cards.title: Caught in the middle
cards.text: {friend} vented to {first} for an hour about a falling-out with someone else.
cards.told: {friend} vented to you for an hour about a falling-out with someone else.

cards.title: A scene at the cafe
cards.text: {first} knocked a full tray of drinks over in a packed cafe.
cards.told: You knocked a full tray of drinks over in a packed cafe.
cards.share: I knocked over a WHOLE TRAY of drinks in a packed cafe today. I'm moving to another country.

cards.title: Overheard
cards.text: {first} overheard {friend} saying something not very nice about them, maybe as a joke.
cards.told: You overheard {friend} saying something not very nice about you, maybe as a joke.

cards.title: Said too much
cards.text: {first} blurted out something embarrassing in front of a room full of people.
cards.told: You blurted out something embarrassing in front of a room full of people.

cards.title: Someone caught their eye
cards.text: Someone new caught {first}'s eye today, and {first} kept smiling about it all day.
cards.told: Someone new caught your eye today, and you have kept thinking about them since. You haven't told anyone.
